data.name: Bartholomeus
data.gender_notes: Bartholomeus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Son of Tholomai, or 'Son of Praise'
data.long_meaning: The name Bartholomeus is derived from the Aramaic name Bar-Tomayo or Bar-Tholomai, which means 'son of Tholomai'. In Greek, it is transliterated as Bartholomaios, which means 'son of Tholomai'. In Latin, it is transliterated as Bartholomeus. In the New Testament, Bartholomeus is one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. He is also known as Nathanael and is often depicted in art as holding a knife.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith, sonship, and praise to God.
data.etymology: Bartholomeus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of Tholomai, or 'Son of Praise'.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bartholomeus total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: ברתולומאוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בר-תולומאוס, פרוש: מבורר קדש, חלופי, שמעון. מקור: עברית. תרגום: 'אב', 'חלופי' (בדומה ל, 'בעל'), 'שמעון'. הברית החדשה (New Testament) אינה כוללת שם 'ברתולומאוס' אך 'ברתולומאוס' נזכר בבשורה על-פי מתי (Matthew 10:3) כאחד מ-12 השליחים. 'ברתולומאוס' נשאר נפוץ בעיקר במזרח קריית. עם כל זאת, 'ברתולומאוס' אינו נזכר במקרא (Hebrew Bible).

in_greek.name: Βαρθολομαῖος
in_greek.long_meaning: Βαρθολομαῖος, προέλευση: εβραϊκή, προέλευση: Βαρ-θολωμαῖος. προέλευση: από-ανθρωπος+μαῖος. Βαρθολομαῖος (Bartolomeos) απεικονίζεται ως ο ανθρωπομορφία, το όνομα του οποίου σημαίνει 'απάνθρωπος'. Βαρθολομαῖος (Bartolomeos) είναι ο τρίτος από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους σύμφωνα με την Πράξη των Αποστόλων (Acts 1:13) και το Ευαγγέλιο του Ματθαίου (Matthew 10:3).

in_latin.name: Bartholomeus
in_latin.long_meaning: Bartholomeus, significatio: 'apostolus', 'apostola', 'sanctus'. Origines: Hebraicum, Origines: Bartholomaeus. Bartholomeus (B) est unus ex duodecim apostolis, secundum Acta Apostolorum (Acts 1:13) et Evangelium secundum Matthaeum (Matthew 10:3).

In the Christian tradition, the name Bartholomeus is associated with the qualities of wisdom, integrity, and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: Bartholomeus is a name of ancient and rich cultural heritage. It is a name that has been passed down through generations, and is still used today in various Christian communities around the world. The name is particularly associated with the culture and traditions of the Middle Ages, when Bartholomew was venerated as a martyr and patron saint of various places and causes. In England, for example, he is the patron saint of butchers and leatherworkers, reflecting the association of his name with the physical act of cutting or tanning.
data.spiritual_significance: Bartholomeus is a name that carries deep spiritual significance. According to tradition, Bartholomeus was a humble and devout follower of Jesus. He was known for his swiftness in recognizing the true nature of Jesus, and for his willingness to follow Jesus even when it meant facing tribulation and persecution. Bartholomeus' legend includes his being sent to various lands to evangelize, and ultimately being martyred by being flayed alive. His courage and dedication to the spread of the Christian message make him an inspiring figure for those who bear his name, and an example of faithful perseverance in the face of adversity.
